verdict.rationale: Kick's docs describe the core building blocks: automatic transaction categorization with confidence-gated exceptions left for manual review (kick-supp-categorization), a documented reconciliation workflow comparing ledger to bank statements (kick-supp-reconciliation), rules that automate handling (kick-docs-18), an MCP/CLI surface explicitly pitched to 'automate month-end checks' and update bookkeeping 'all with your approval' (kick-docs-15, kick-docs-16), and an audit trail that logs AI agent actions for human review (kick-supp-audit-trail). This maps closely to matching, flagging exceptions, and prepping for review. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end demonstration of an agent autonomously executing a full month-end close via MCP, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
